dishes.name: Volcano Taquitos

dishes.name: OldTownScrambled
dishes.description: A savory, high-energy scramble of fluffy farm-fresh eggs and tender Pacific shrimp. Choose your favorite side: Potatoes, Hashbrowns, Fruit.

dishes.name: Meat Paradise Scrambled
dishes.description: The ultimate protein-packed start. A savory scramble of farm-fresh eggs loaded with crispy bacon, country pork sausage, and diced smoked ham. Topped with a melted three-cheese blend. Choose your favorite side: Potatoes, Hashbrowns, Fruit.

dishes.name: Eggs your Way
dishes.description: Two farm-fresh eggs prepared exactly how you like them. Choose your favorite protein: crispy bacon, savory pork sausage links, or sliced ham. Choose your favorite side: Potatoes, Hashbrowns, Fruit

dishes.name: Avo Dream Toast
dishes.description: Two slices of thick-cut artisan bread toasted to a golden crisp and layered with hand-smashed avocados. Topped with a vibrant medley of halved cherry tomatoes, salty Greek feta cheese, and aromatic fresh basil. Finished with two eggs any style and a light drizzle of extra virgin olive oil.

dishes.name: Del Rancho Eggs
dishes.description: A vibrant San Diego classic. Two golden fried eggs layered atop corn tortillas and drenched in signature salsa. Finished with the perfect balance of salty feta cheese, sour cream, and fresh onions. Served with traditional rice and beans. Order it "Divorsiados" style with half red half green sauce.

dishes.name: Eggcellent steak
dishes.description: The ultimate high-protein start. A juicy, flame-grilled steak prepared to your liking and served along side two fresh eggs any style. Accompanied by your choice of our signature homestyle potatoes, crispy golden hash-browns, or fresh seasonal fruit, served with toasted artisan bread.

dishes.name: ABC all along
dishes.description: The ultimate California trio. A fluffy three-egg omelette folded with crispy bacon and melted sharp cheddar cheese. Topped with a generous portion of fresh-sliced avocado. Choose your favorite side: Potatoes, Hashbrowns, Fruit.

dishes.name: Denver Classic
dishes.description: A timeless breakfast favorite. Three fluffy farm-fresh eggs folded with diced smoked ham, crisp bell peppers, and sauteed onions. Choose your favorite side: Potatoes, Hashbrowns, Fruit.

dishes.description: Craft your perfect morning. Choose any three ingredients from our garden, butcher, and creamery selection to be folded into three fluffy farm-fresh eggs. Choose your favorite side: Potatoes, Hashbrowns, Fruit

dishes.name: Garden Harvest
dishes.description: A vibrant, three-egg omelette overflowing with sauteed broccoli florets, bell peppers, and fresh spinach. Choose your favorite side: Potatoes, Hashbrowns, Fruit

dishes.name: A lo Mexa
dishes.description: A three-egg powerhouse folded with spicy house-made chorizo and a fiery blend of fresh serrano peppers and onions. Sauteed tomatoes add a touch of sweetness, while crumbled feta cheese provides a creamy, savory finish. Choose your favorite side: Potatoes, Hashbrowns, Fruit.

dishes.name: Mexi Benedict
dishes.description: A bold, flavorful twist on a brunch favorite. Savory, spiced pork chorizo served over a toasted, buttery English muffin with two perfectly poached farm-fresh eggs. Smothered in our creamy, house-made chipotle mayo for an extra zesty kick. Choose your favorite side: Potatoes, Hashbrowns, Fruit.

dishes.name: Perfect Benedict

dishes.name: Prime Benedict

Choose your favorite side: Potatoes, Hashbrowns, Fruit.

dishes.description: Experience our ultimate house specialty, served in a traditional volcanic stone mortar. Topped with fresh nopal, charred green onions, spicy chiles toreados, and our signature mole sauce. Dish is served with sides of savory rice, beans, and warm tortillas for the celebration.

dishes.name: Fajitas de la Casa
